maria.s: Quick sync — we need to finalize audit-log coverage/schema + archive/immutability/KMS plan for customer-facing exports. Legal asked for WORM + downloadable proof packages. Questions inline, looking for short answers. @alex.t @priya.k @sam.legal

alex.t: High-level take: split internal operational events from customer-facing exports. Customer bundles must be: canonical JSON schema, tamper-evident proof (signature/chain), and retention/legal-hold support. Any objections? :thinking:

priya.k: Schema proposal (very terse): fields: event_id, timestamp, event_type, actor_id, actor_email, resource_id, resource_type, action, request_id, metadata (kv), before, after, checksum. Publish as JSON Schema and provide a validator lib. Keep payloads small and consistent.

alex.t: Implementation notes: for tamper-evidence we can sign each exported file (or the manifest) with a dedicated signing key and store detached signature alongside. Option: generate a Merkle root for a batch and sign the root. Example schema snippet: ```json
{"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"event_id":{"type":"string"},"timestamp":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"event_type":{"type":"string"},"actor_id":{"type":"string"},"resource_id":{"type":"string"},"action":{"type":"string"}},"required":["event_id","timestamp","event_type","actor_id","resource_id","action"]}```

sam.legal: From compliance: they prefer true WORM (S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode) + retention + legal-hold APIs we can surface to legal. Customers will want proof that we didn't alter exports; signature + timestamp + immutable storage should suffice. For some customers (regulated) they may require BYOK or split custody. We'll flag that in contract templates.

maria.s: Ops questions: we currently use S3 + SSE-KMS. Do we need a dedicated CMK per customer or per-tenant key alias? How to prevent accidental key deletion or rotation from breaking the ability to prove/archive?

security-oncall: Checklist (short):
- Create S3 bucket with Object Lock enabled at creation (cannot enable after). Use COMPLIANCE mode for true WORM.
- Set retention period per contract (e.g., 7y/10y) and support LegalHold toggles.
- Use a dedicated CMK per-customer where contract requires BYOK or split custody; otherwise a regional CMK with strict key policy and disabled deletion is fine.
- Do NOT schedule automatic key deletion; restrict key admins to security+ops. Rotation is allowed (AWS-managed rotation keeps decrypt support), but ensure archived proofs are also signed with key metadata recorded (key id + key version).
- Store signature/manifest as separate object with the same retention policy.

ops-bot: Quick AWS snippets: (bucket must be created with Object Lock enabled)
```bash
aws s3api create-bucket --bucket my-audit-archive-123 --object-lock-enabled-for-bucket --region us-west-2
# put object with retention (COMPLIANCE)
aws s3api put-object --bucket my-audit-archive-123 --key exports/2025-11-01/batch.ndjson --body batch.ndjson --server-side-encryption aws:kms --ssekms-key-id alias/reports-cmk
aws s3api put-object-retention --bucket my-audit-archive-123 --key exports/2025-11-01/batch.ndjson --retention '{"Mode":"COMPLIANCE","RetainUntilDate":"2032-11-01T00:00:00Z"}'
# sign with KMS (example using asymmetric signing key)
aws kms sign --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd --message fileb://manifest.sha256 --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256 --output text > manifest.sig
```

alex.t: Incident triage notes (short): if exports stop or proofs mismatch: check pipeline (backlog), S3 PutObject errors, KMS AccessDenied or KeyUnavailable, and Object Lock state. Common failure mode: someone deletes the CMK (or schedules deletion) -> decrypt/sign fails. If proof mismatch detected, freeze exports, run consistency check (recompute checksums/merkle) and re-sign from immutable backups, notify legal and affected customers.

priya.k: Proposed action items: publish canonical JSON Schema + a small JS/Python validator; define a signature envelope (JWS detached or KMS-signed detached blob) and a standard manifest format (file list + merkle root + key id + signature). Ops: draft S3+KMS runbook + steps to create compliance-mode buckets and per-customer CMKs for BYOK. Legal: signoff on retention durations and legal-hold process. I'll write PRs for schema + validator next week. :white_check_mark:
